records.title: Lobed Star Coral / Orbicella annularis
records.author: Patric Lengacher

license.label: CC Attribution
license.requirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.

records.description:
A detail scan of an OANN coral. Also known as Lobed Star Coral or Orbicella annularis. The largest chunk is about 25cm x 40cm. One small part of the colony shows a white area where the coral skeleton is exposed, due to a disease.

21 Photos taken in Roatan, Honduras with a 15mm fisheye lens, processed in Agisoft Metashape Standard

Support the [Roatan Marine Park](https://www.roatanmarinepark.org/) in their efforts to treat affected corals and protect the reef.

records.title: Stove-pipe Sponge / Aplysina archeri
records.author: Patric Lengacher

license.label: CC Attribution
license.requirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.

records.description:
A couple of tube sponges growing on a little ledge. Although it might appear that the scan is not complete on one of the tubes, in reality it was a damaged / deformed sponge.

A fairy basslet sneaked into one of the pictures, can you spot it?

21 Photos taken in Roatan, Honduras with a 15mm fisheye lens, processed in Agisoft Metashape Standard

Support the [Roatan Marine Park](http://wwwhttps://www.roatanmarinepark.org/) in their efforts to treat affected corals and protect the reef.
records.changes: Selected the complete main tube cluster using one fixed XYZ region; removed surrounding ledge. Decimated to 6499 triangles, normalized all axes equally to height=1. Open basal cuts; no invented cap or tube repair. Original image bytes retained.
records.limitations: Roatan Caribbean sources used as explicitly cross-region visual reference in this authored sample; not a reconstruction of one Indo-Pacific field site. Lobed source includes one diseased/exposed area described by its author.
